subject: Game Theory
title: Term Limits
description: A quick, practical guide to Term Limits.

hook.text: US presidents serve a maximum of two terms. Without limits, incumbents might never leave power.

buildup.text: Term limits solve a commitment problem: leaders promise to step down, but once powerful, why would they?

discovery.text: Fixed terms create enforceable rotation. The rule binds leaders before they gain the power to ignore it.

twist.text: But term limits waste experienced leaders and make lame ducks of outgoing officials who can't be reelected.

climax.text: Russia and China modified term limits to extend leaders' rule—showing how fragile the constraint can be.

quiz.question: What problem do term limits solve?
